ci-bot: [ALERT] microbench threshold diff in PR #16600
ci-bot: kv_cache_microbench: tail_latency_p95 increased by 12.4% (threshold 5.0%). Job: https://ci.redwood/rig/7254321
marta: saw this on the merge candidate, tagging eng-runtime. reproducible locally?
raj: I can repro on perf-runner. running quick job now.
raj: command:
```
./scripts/run_microbench --bench kv_cache --runs 5 --seed 42
```
raj: baseline p95=43.2ms -> PR p95=48.6ms. numbers stable across 5 runs.
devon: quick skim of the PR diff shows changes to kernel_selector cost model + preference for int8 concat kernel.
oliver: did the batcher heuristics change too? PR touched batcher slotting earlier.
devon: only kernel_selector logic should affect pathing; could cause different kernel to be chosen for certain seq len distribution.
raj: flamegraph (perf-runner): https://perf.redwood/graphs/7254321/fg.svg -> shows heavy time in concat_int8_kernel::eval
perf-bot: note: kv_cache microbench uses seq=64, batch_size=8 typical for this bench.
marta: plan: bisect commits in PR landing range. raj can you bisect commit range head~5..head and report earliest bad commit?
raj: starting bisect now. will post minimal repro and commit.
raj: bisect result: commit abc1234 (kernel_selector: add heuristics for int8 affinity) is first bad.
devon: that change bumped the cost weight for int8 by -0.15 (making int8 favored). For concat geometry this makes scheduling pick int8 which is slower on our CUDA kernels for small batch sizes.
oliver: interesting — int8 path faster bulk but regresses small-batch tail. we need a heuristic depending on batch size/seq length.
marta: immediate action: revert the commit in a hotfix PR and block the rollout until we ship a targeted fix. can someone open revert PR and add a microbench unit that exercises small-batch concat path?
devon: I'll open PR 16605 to revert abc1234 and add a regression test for seq=64 batch=8 concat microbench.
marta: setting rollout status: BLOCKED until revert merged. @ci-bot please stop merge window for this candidate.
ci-bot: rollback hold acknowledged. Scheduling new perf run on revert candidate.
raj: after applying the revert locally p95 back to 43.0ms. confirming fix.
marta: thanks team — once revert merges we can rework kernel_selector with a more nuanced cost model and add tunables.
ci-bot: new job: https://ci.redwood/rig/7254322 queued for revert PR #16605
